question.text: Under the SEBI (FPI) Regulations, 2019, the registration granted to an FPI by the DDP is:

answer.text: Valid for 5 years and subject to renewal
Valid for 1 year and must be renewed annually
Valid for 3 years and subject to renewal
Permanent, unless suspended or cancelled by SEBI or surrendered by the FPI

explanation.text: The Logic: Registration granted by the DDP on behalf of SEBI is permanent unless suspended or cancelled by SEBI, or surrendered by the FPI itself. The Trap: Fixed-tenure validity (1, 3, or 5 years with renewal) is not the current FPI position; the certificate runs until one of the listed termination events occurs. Note: Permanent status removes the renewal cycle but does not change the FPI's ongoing compliance obligations under the regulations.
